ctaHeading: Melbourne plumbers are ready — let's fix your plumbing issue.
aboutText: Established in Melbourne, Lovell Plumbing brings over a decade of experience to every job. We specialise in quick fixes and long-term solutions, using the latest tools. Our team is committed to reliable service, making us a trusted name in the community. With a focus on customer satisfaction, we offer transparent pricing and no hidden fees.
servicesText: At Lovell Plumbing, we offer a comprehensive range of services including emergency repairs, drain clearing, and fixture installations. Our skilled team handles both residential and commercial jobs, ensuring efficient and durable solutions. We use high-quality materials to guarantee lasting results.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: We provide 24/7 emergency plumbing services across Melbourne, ensuring quick response to urgent issues like burst pipes or severe leaks.

services.title: Drain Clearing
services.desc: Our team uses advanced techniques to clear blocked drains, preventing further damage and restoring proper flow to your plumbing system.

services.title: Pipe Repair
services.desc: From minor leaks to major pipe replacements, we offer reliable repair services to keep your plumbing in top condition.

services.title: Fixture Installation
services.desc: We install and replace taps, showers, toilets, and other fixtures with precision, enhancing the functionality of your space.

services.title: Gas Fitting
services.desc: Our licensed gas fitters handle installations and repairs for gas appliances, ensuring safety and compliance with regulations.

services.title: Hot Water Systems
services.desc: We install, repair, and maintain hot water systems, providing efficient solutions for consistent hot water supply in your home.

bannerSubheading: Fast and reliable plumbing solutions for your home or business.
contactSubheading: We respond promptly to all inquiries
